piece.dm_text:
Here is how to automate daily lead entry using Zapier:
1. Create a free Zapier account and connect your lead source (like Facebook Lead Ads or Google Forms) and destination apps (Google Sheets and Gmail).
2. Set the Trigger to 'New Lead' or 'New Form Response'.
3. Set Action 1 to 'Create Spreadsheet Row' in your Google Sheet.
4. Set Action 2 to 'Send Email' in Gmail to send an instant follow-up to the lead.
5. Alternatively, connect Zapier as a plugin or MCP server in ChatGPT or Claude and prompt: 'When a new lead arrives from my form, add them to Google Sheets and email them a confirmation.' Zapier handles 10,000+ apps automatically.

[64] Zapier Blog — Zapier examples: Ways to use automation at work
URL: https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-automation-examples
Put the busywork on autopilot with these tips and tricks
When you want to get more done and have more impact at work, automation can help. Zapier helps you turn your tools into powerful processes. Whether you need to automate a simple task or build an entire automated system, you can do it all on Zapier.
We've collected some of the best Zapier examples across different industries and roles, so you can find something to help you get more done, no matter what you do at work. Click on any of the headings below to be taken to an in-depth article, or copy a prompt to build the example directly from your AI agent.
Build automations from wherever you work. Describe the outcome you want, and Zapier connects your tools, runs the steps, and stays on the job after you close the chat. Combine AI with reliable, deterministic automation across 10,000+ apps. Get started for free.
Zapier connects 10,000+ apps, so work can move between them without you copying and pasting. Every automation is a Zap, an automated workflow that starts when something happens in one app (like a new form entry), or on a schedule (like every Monday morning). It then does the work in your other apps. Zaps use AI only for the steps that need judgment—like deciding whether a message is a sales lead—and run everything else the same way every time.
You can build Zaps directly from your AI assistant. Add Zapier as a connector or a custom MCP server, then connect the apps you use, like Gmail, Slack, and Google Sheets. Just connect once—the same connections work from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any AI tool you like. Describe the job in plain language, and your agent drafts the Zap and deploys it to Zapier, which keeps it running whether or not your laptop is open. Or build it in Zapier itself, starting from a template or the Zap editor.
Start with the team or job closest to yours. Each heading below links to an in-depth article on that area, and each prompt is something you can paste into your AI assistant once Zapier is connected, then adjust to the apps you use.
These are some of the most-used automated workflows people set up with Zapier, covering things like social media, task management, note-taking, feedback collection, and reminders.
Project management is all about keeping everyone working together. Automation can streamline task creation, communication, and more by automatically creating tasks and sending custom notifications—no matter what apps you're using to get work done.
Say a deal closes and nobody remembers to kick off the work. A Zap can start the moment the deal moves, so the project exists before the handoff email is sent.
Copy Build on Zapier: When a deal moves to Closed Won in HubSpot, create a project in Asana from my onboarding template and assign the kickoff task to the account owner. Learn more: How to use Zapier and AI to streamline project management
Just about everyone uses email for something, but that means you can end up with more going on in your inbox than you can easily manage. Automation can help you keep things organized and on track.
Your agent can draft a reply in chat, but a Zap is what notices the new email, labels it, and logs it while you're away from your desk.
Copy Build on Zapier: Label each new email in Gmail by intent, like support, sales, or invoice, and send me a digest in Slack at 5 p.m. If your inbox is under control, check out these ways to automate your email marketing .
Contact forms are an easy way to get information from your prospects and customers. Move faster by adding automation to your processes so your team gets notified of every new lead or contact.
Leads go cold when a form entry sits in an inbox. A Zap starts when the form is submitted, so the right person hears about it right away.
Copy Build on Zapier: When someone submits my website contact form, add them to HubSpot, post in #leads in Slack, and email them a confirmation. If the message mentions pricing, mark it high priority. Sales and CRM
Keep your pipeline current without anyone doing data entry. Zaps can create the contact when a lead arrives, update the deal when a stage changes, and ping the owner when a deal goes quiet.
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead arrives from Facebook Lead Ads, add them to HubSpot, summarize their answers with AI, and message the assigned rep in Slack. Marketing
From the first signup to the follow-up, Zaps can move leads between your forms, ad platforms, email tools, and CRM, so campaigns run without a weekly copy-and-paste ritual.
Copy Build on Zapier: When someone signs up for my webinar, add them to a Mailchimp list, tag them by the campaign they came from, and add a row to my tracking sheet in Google Sheets. Finance and invoicing
Invoices, receipts, and payment alerts tend to pile up. Zaps can log each one where your books expect it and flag the ones that need a person.
Copy Build on Zapier: When a payment fails in Stripe, add a row to a Google Sheet with the customer and amount, and send my finance channel in Slack a message. IT and ops
Routine requests don't need a person to move them along. Zaps can open the ticket, notify the on-call owner, and keep an audit trail in a spreadsheet.
Copy Build on Zapier: When someone fills out the new-laptop request form, create a Jira ticket, assign it to IT, and post a note in #it-help. AI workflows
Some jobs need judgment, like sorting a message or summarizing a call. Zaps can add an AI step only where it's needed and keep every other step the same each run.
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new support email arrives in Gmail, use AI to decide if it's a bug report, a billing question, or a feature request, then create the right task in Asana and reply with a confirmation. Note-taking
Turn your ideas into action by adding automation to your note-taking. With Zapier, you can create tasks from notes, automatically create documents for new meetings, organize your ideas, and create backups.
Copy Build on Zapier: When I star a note in Evernote, create a task for it in Todoist with a due date of tomorrow. eCommerce
If you're selling online there are opportunities for automation, from sharing new products on social to customized sale (and failed sale) notifications.
A failed order or a big refund is easy to miss in a busy store. A Zap can catch it the moment it happens.
Copy Build on Zapier: When a Shopify order fails or a refund is over $100, log it in a Google Sheet and alert me in Slack. Social media
No matter where your audience is—or how you're using social media—automation can help you move faster and have greater impact. From crossposting to tracking to brand monitoring, Zapier makes it easier.
Copy Build on Zapier: Whenever we publish a new blog post, draft a LinkedIn post that summarizes it. Then, save it in Buffer for me to review. Files and folders

[66] Zapier Blog — 5 systems you should automate today
URL: https://zapier.com/blog/what-you-should-automate
The people on your team have extraordinary ideas. But their brilliance can't surface, much less get deployed at scale, if everyone's bogged down with disconnected tools and colorless operational work.
Unless they delegate that work to Zapier, that is. On our platform, you can build secure, AI-powered systems that connect perfectly with each other and the 10,000+ apps in our ecosystem.
If you're ready to replace rote work and chaos with coordination, keep scrolling. I've put together five systems that are ripe for automation—complete with ready-to-use Zapier templates and tips to help you start automating fast, regardless of your role or experience with building these kinds of systems.
You can build every one of them two ways: start from a Zap template, or add Zapier to your AI tool and describe what you want in a prompt. In each section below, you'll find the templates and the prompts you can paste into Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to get the same result.
To use the templates and prompts in this article: For the templates, just click the button to try it, and you'll be brought to the Zapier editor. For the prompts, connect Zapier to your AI tool first, then connect the apps you want to automate. Paste a prompt, swap in your own apps, and your agent will draft the Zap. Either way, once it's live, the Zap runs on its own.
Notify your team about new leads or customers
Automatically create and track calendar events
Consolidate information in a spreadsheet or database
Build automations from wherever you work. Describe the outcome you want, and Zapier connects your tools, runs the steps, and stays on the job after you close the chat. Combine AI with reliable, deterministic automation across 10,000+ apps. Get started for free.
Message your team about leads or customers
If a lead comes in and nobody acts on it, did it actually come in? We can't answer that question—we'll leave that to philosophers—but what we can do is help you make sure this never happens.
You could say it's one of the things we do best. People commonly use Zapier to notify teammates about leads.
It's a simple Zap—what we call our automated workflows—to set up. All you need to do is connect whatever source you're getting leads from to whatever communication tool your sales or marketing team uses the most. That way your team gets notified every time a new lead comes in, in the place they're most likely to see it, so they can take action right away.
For example, you could send an email to your team whenever a lead comes in. Here are some quick Zap workflows to get you started.
Send emails in Gmail for new leads in Facebook Lead Ads
Get emails with new Facebook Lead Ads leads
Dispatch emails in Microsoft Outlook with new leads in Facebook Lead Ads
You could also set up notifications in your team chat app, either in a public channel or as a private message.
Post new LinkedIn Lead Gen Form leads to Microsoft Teams
Send new TikTok Lead Generation leads to Google Hangouts Chat
Get Slack channel notifications for new Facebook Lead Ads
Send channel messages on Discord for new Google Ads leads
Send SMS messages for new leads from Facebook Lead Ads
Send SMS messages for new Google Ads leads
Send SMS messages for new TikTok Lead Generation leads
You could even add a filter step to notify your team only when certain conditions are met—like if the lead comes from a specific campaign, has a company email address, or includes key details like job title or budget. It's a smart way to focus on high-quality leads and avoid notification overload.
Send Gmail emails for filtered leads from LinkedIn Ads
Send Slack channel messages for filtered leads from Facebook
Paste any of these into your AI tool. Swap in the apps you actually use. Click Copy and then paste the prompt directly in your AI agent.
Copy Build on Zapier: Whenever a new lead comes into [HubSpot], send an email to [sales@yourcompany.com] with the lead's name, company, and email address. Team chat alert
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead is added to [Salesforce], post a message in the #sales channel in [Slack] with the lead's name, company, and lead source. Private message to the lead owner
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead is assigned to someone in [HubSpot], send that person a direct message in [Slack] with the lead's details and a link to the record. SMS alert
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead fills out my [Typeform] form, text me the lead's name and phone number. Only the leads that matter
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead comes into [HubSpot], only notify #sales in [Slack] if the lead has a company email address and a job title that includes 'Director' or 'VP.' Skip everyone else. Your agent will build each of these as a Zap that starts the moment a lead comes in, so your team hears about it right away, not at the next scheduled check.
It's one thing to find out about new leads quickly, but what if you could follow up with leads without needing to do anything? It sounds like a dream, but you can also set that up with Zapier.
You could instantly follow up with new leads via SMS or email by having Zapier automatically send a message to your new leads.
Send emails in Gmail for new leads in Facebook Lead Ads
Send new Facebook Lead Ads leads a text message via ClickSend SMS
Send Kudosity messages for new Google Ads leads
Send Gmail emails to new TikTok Lead Generation leads
Send SMS messages via Twilio to new LinkedIn Lead Gen Form leads
You could also sign those leads up for your email newsletter, saving you from having to add them manually. Just make sure they've opted into the subscription first to make sure you're staying compliant with GDPR .
Subscribe new Facebook Lead Ad leads to a Mailchimp list
Add LinkedIn Lead Gen Form leads as new contacts in ActiveCampaign
Subscribe new TikTok Lead Generation leads to a Mailchimp list
Add contacts in ActiveCampaign for new leads from Google Ads
You can even add an AI step using ChatGPT or AI by Zapier to generate more personalized emails. Stand out from the crowd without putting in any extra effort—just sign off and click Send .
Write new LinkedIn Ads leads emails with ChatGPT and send in Gmail
Write AI-generated emails to LinkedIn Ads leads with AI by Zapier
These prompts let you build the Zaps directly from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or any AI tool you use.
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead comes in through [Facebook Lead Ads], send them a short, friendly email from [Gmail] thanking them and asking when they're free for a call. Instant follow-up SMS
Copy Build on Zapier: When someone submits my [Google Forms] contact form, send them a text confirming we received their request. Newsletter signup
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead in [HubSpot] marks 'subscribed to newsletter' as yes, add them to my [Mailchimp] audience. Only add people who have opted in. Personalized with AI
Copy Build on Zapier: When a new lead comes into [HubSpot], draft a personalized follow-up email in [Gmail] using the lead's company
